name: Illyuziya Vybora
source:
Psychological horror about a girl who spends her whole life trying to "be like everyone else."

You are her inner voice — the one who makes choices for her. Who makes the right choice: not to see too much, not to hear too much, and not to say too much.

[From [url=https://innerspaced.itch.io/illusionofchoice]itch.io[/url]]
